deals.comment: Start Today Co., Ltd. (TSE: 3092) signed a share transfer contract to acquire the remaining 70% stake in Crown Jewel, Inc. from CyberAgent, Inc. (TSE: 4751) and Takeyuki Fukumoto for approximately ¥700 million on May 27, 2011. Start Today Co., Ltd will acquire 22,200 shares of Crown Jewel, Inc. CyberAgent, Inc. and Takeyuki Fukumoto will sell their respective stakes of 69.62% and 0.38% in Crown Jewel, Inc. After completion of the transaction, Start Today Co., Ltd. will hold 100% stake in Crown Jewel, Inc. For the year ended September 2010, Crown Jewel Inc. reported sales of ¥665.07 million, operating profit of ¥13.67 million, total assets of ¥307.59 million and net assets of ¥237.48 million. The transaction was resolved by the Board of Directors on May 27, 2011 and is expected to complete on June 10, 2011.

Start Today Co., Ltd. (TSE:3092) agreed to acquire Yappa Corporation from Masahiro Ito, Tetsuro Funai, Morisawa Inc. and other shareholders for ¥1 billion on July 31, 2014. As per the terms, Masahiro Ito is selling its 28.4% stake, Tetsuro Funai is selling its 26.3% stake, Morisawa Inc. is selling its 17.9% stake and other shareholders will sell 11.8% stake. The consideration includes issuance of 8.7 shares of Start Today for every one share of Yappa Corporation. A total of 0.38 million shares of Start Today will be issued as part of the transaction. For the period ending June 2014, Yappa reported total assets of ¥166 million, net assets of ¥29 million, sales of ¥210 million, operating profit of ¥7 million and net profit of ¥0 million. Shareholders’ meeting of Yappa for approval of the share exchange is expected to be held on August 19, 2014 and the transaction is expected to be closed by October 1, 2014. Credit Suisse Securities (Japan) Limited acted as financial advisor to Yappa Corporation.

Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) resolved to implement an offer to acquire 50.1% stake in ZOZO, Inc. (TSE:3092) from Yusaku Maezawa and others for approximately ¥400 billion on September 12, 2019. Yusaku Maezawa agreed to tender 92.7 million shares on September 12, 2019. Yahoo will pay ¥2,620 per share. Post completion, ZOZO will become subsidiary of Yahoo and will remain listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Yahoo would be entitled to appoint two persons as Directors of ZOZO and Yusaku Maezawa will resign as Director of ZOZO. The offer is subject to resolution of Board of ZOZO to support the offer, minimum number of 101.97 million shares in order to ensure that Yahoo shareholding increases to 33.40% and maximum number to be purchased under the offer is 153 million shares. As of September 27, 2019, the tender offer will start from September 30, 2019 and will end on November 13, 2019. At its board of Directors’ meeting held on September 12, 2019, Yahoo resolved to implement the offer and ZOZO Board intends to support the offer. Yahoo is aiming at commencing the Tender Offer in early October 2019. SMBC Nikko Securities Inc. acted as financial adviser and Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu acted as legal adviser for ZOZO. Mizuho Securities Co., Ltd. acted as the financial advisor and SBI SECURITIES Co., Ltd. acted as tender offer agent for Yahoo in the transaction.
